#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=tmol-reference-audit
#SBATCH --partition=hpc-low
#SBATCH --gpus=1
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=4
#SBATCH --mem=32G
#SBATCH --time=00:30:00
#SBATCH --output=/mnt/home/kdidi/tmol-pr503-followup/noncanonical-current-20260912-%j.log
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/home/kdidi/projects/tmol-pr503-review
export PYTHONPATH=.
export TMOL_USE_JIT=1
export TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=9.0
export MAX_JOBS=4
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=2
export SPARSE_AUTO_DENSIFY=1
export TORCH_EXTENSIONS_DIR=/mnt/home/kdidi/tmol-pr503-results/extensions-candidate
status=0
apptainer exec --nv --bind /mnt:/mnt /mnt/data/kdidi/apptainers/latent-dev-cuda13-26.06-tmol0.1.54.sif python -m pytest -q tmol/tests/score/test_noncanonical_scoring.py --junitxml=/mnt/home/kdidi/tmol-pr503-followup/noncanonical-current-20260912-gpu.xml || status=$?
apptainer exec --nv --bind /mnt:/mnt /mnt/data/kdidi/apptainers/latent-dev-cuda13-26.06-tmol0.1.54.sif python review/pr503/diagnose_noncanonical_scores.py --device cuda:0 --replay review/pr503/fixtures/noncanonical-score-replay --output /mnt/home/kdidi/tmol-pr503-followup/noncanonical-current-20260912-replay-cuda
exit "$status"
